assessment: bounded prescan, not a comprehensive privacy guarantee; external final receipt binds scan of complete sealed set
prescan_scope: 237 scratch files before privacy documentation and manifest
digest_scan: 40 digests derived from restricted evidence, bounded 128 MiB per view and recursion depth 18; no forbidden digest, candidate or exception in prescan
pattern_scan: flat regular bytes with escaped slashes normalized, local home/temporary/Windows user/email/credential patterns; no matches in prescan
exclusions: unknown sensitive values or encodings, unsupported formats, omitted symlinks, Git administrative metadata and history; raw commit metadata and full private queues remain external
rerun: final complete packet scan including manifest separately receipted to avoid self-referential digests; the digest scanner requires private corpus
